name: 暗夜
description: 粉紫蓝渐变 #F472B6/#8B5CF6/#60A5FA，赛博朋克霓虹光效，适合 AI/Web3/科技前沿话题

styles.h1: font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #ffffff; text-align: center; letter-spacing: 0.1em; line-height: 1.2; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F472B6 0%, #8B5CF6 50%, #60A5FA 100%); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(244,114,182,0.25), 0 2px 8px rgba(139,92,246,0.15); margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 16px;
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #1d1d1f; line-height: 1.2; border-bottom: 1px dashed #8B5CF6; border-radius: 4px; background: radial-gradient(80.23% 80.23% at 50% 88.37%, rgba(174,78,245,0.22) 0%, rgba(174,78,245,0) 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(174,78,245,0.15), inset 3px 0 0 0 #F472B6, inset 2px 0 0 0 #8B5CF6, inset 1px 0 0 0 #60A5FA; margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 12px;
styles.h3: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #1d1d1f; line-height: 1.2; border-radius: 3px; background: radial-gradient(80.23% 80.23% at 50% 88.37%, rgba(139,92,246,0.18) 0%, rgba(139,92,246,0) 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(139,92,246,0.12), inset 2.5px 0 0 0 #8B5CF6, inset 1.5px 0 0 0 #60A5FA; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 12px;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.8; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 19px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 4px solid #8B5CF6; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(244,114,182,0.06), rgba(139,92,246,0.04)); margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0; font-size: 15px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.7;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 10px; display: block; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(139,92,246,0.12); background: #ffffff; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 40px; margin-bottom: 40px; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(244,114,182,0), #F472B6, #8B5CF6, #60A5FA, rgba(96,165,250,0)); border: none;
styles.code: background: rgba(139,92,246,0.1); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 90%; color: #8B5CF6; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, Menlo, monospace;
styles.pre: background: #fbfbfd; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(168,85,247,0.1); color: #1d1d1f; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-all;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 3px; background: linear-gradient(to right, #F472B6, #8B5CF6, #60A5FA);
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #1d1d1f; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, Menlo, monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: 15px; border-spacing: 0; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(168,85,247,0.08);
styles.th: background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(244,114,182,0.03), rgba(168,85,247,0.02)); border-bottom: 1.5px solid rgba(168,85,247,0.1); text-align: left; font-weight: 600; color: #1d1d1f;
styles.ol li::marker: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; min-width: 22px; background: rgba(139,92,246,0.1); color: #8B5CF6; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 10px; margin-top: 4px;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #333333; line-height: 1.75; letter-spacing: 0.5px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 6px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #999999; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
styles.h4: font-size: 17px; font-weight: bold; color: #1d1d1f; border-left: 2px solid #8B5CF6; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h5: font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; color: #555555; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h6: font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #888888; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
